description: Offline Unity platform/build-target and version-define reference used by the platform-info Sense ability. Lists the predefined symbols Unity defines per platform and the version-gate defines used for conditional compilation. Read-only, no Editor required.

platforms.name: Windows
platforms.notes: StandaloneWindows is the 32-bit build target; prefer StandaloneWindows64.

platforms.name: macOS
platforms.notes: Universal (Intel + Apple silicon) builds target StandaloneOSX.

platforms.name: Linux
platforms.notes: Only 64-bit Linux is supported in current Unity versions.

platforms.name: Android
platforms.scriptingBackend: IL2CPP (default; Mono available for some configurations)
platforms.notes: Split by architecture (ARM64, ARMv7) with UNITY_ANDROID; IL2CPP is the default and is required for 64-bit and Google Play submissions, while Mono remains available for some development configurations.

platforms.name: iOS
platforms.notes: Requires an Apple developer toolchain to produce the Xcode project.

platforms.name: WebGL
platforms.notes: No threads or sockets by default; keep managed allocations low.

platforms.name: UWP
platforms.notes: Targets Windows 10/11 and Xbox via the WSA platform.

platforms.name: Editor
platforms.notes: UNITY_EDITOR is defined only in the Editor; guard editor-only code with it.

versionDefines.summary: True on 2023.1 and later; FindFirstObjectByType APIs are current here.
